analysis_steps.goal: Measure continuum flux densities of five images

method.value: Aperture photometry on primary-beam corrected ALMA map, apertures extend two beams beyond 2 sigma contours

evidence.quote: using apertures that fit all of the continuum emission and extend two beams beyond the $2 \sigma$ contours

method.value: Simultaneous single-Gaussian fits to lines with linear continuum, anchoring OH+ velocity and width together and emission lines together

evidence.quote: we simultaneously fitted each of the molecular emission and absorption lines with a single Gaussian component and the underlying continuum with a linear curve
Using the `curve_fit` procedure

method.value: Optically thin and general-form modified black body fits with CMB correction

evidence.quote: a single-temperature modified black-body (MBB) in the optically-thin approximation and a MBB model in its general form

evidence.quote: We adopt the $\kappa_\nu$ re-normalization by (cite: draine2014).

analysis_steps.goal: Lens modeling: point images then pixel-based source reconstruction

method.value: Two-stage: point-source modeling with four SIE galaxies plus shear (with and without a fifth cored-isothermal or NFW halo), then pixsrc reconstruction on ALMA 292 GHz data

evidence.quote: we conducted the lens modeling in a two-stage approach.

evidence.quote: We assumed position uncertainties of $0.03\ensuremath{''}$.
increasing the noise level in *pixsrc* to $\rm 80 \, \mu Jy/beam$ provides the best balance between goodness of fit and regularization

results_numeric.quantity: Predicted C-image delay relative to NE (cored)

findings_qualitative.value: All five images share the same redshift and show OH+ outflow absorption.

evidence.quote: unambiguously demonstrating that the five images have the same redshift ($z$=3.0607)

findings_qualitative.value: First Einstein cross detected at sub-mm wavelengths with a central fifth image.

evidence.quote: This is the first time that a gravitationally amplified high-$z$ galaxy is seen in an Einstein cross system with an image of the background galaxy at the center of the cross

claims.hypothesis: Four visible galaxies alone can reproduce the five-image configuration
claims.experiment: Lens models with G1-G4 plus shear, mild and strong shape priors
claims.result: Mild priors give chi2=104 and need an overly elongated G3; strong priors give chi2=300 with 0.13'' rms offset

evidence.quote: The resulting model has more plausible galaxy shapes but it cannot reproduce the image positions very well (panel b)

claims.hypothesis: An additional massive dark matter halo explains the images
claims.experiment: Add cored isothermal or NFW halo and reconstruct the source with pixsrc
claims.result: rms offset between observed and model peaks <0.02''; halo 3-7'' SE of G1
claims.finding: A massive dark matter halo is indicated; its internal profile is unconstrained

evidence.quote: With the additional mass component, the lens model and observed configuration are in excellent agreement

claims.hypothesis: HerS-3 is a nuclear starburst with outflow and high excitation
claims.experiment: Line fits, CO SLED LVG model, SED
claims.result: OH+ blueshift ~350 km/s, t_depl=152 Myr, inclination ~66 deg
claims.finding: Infrared luminous starburst with outflow, likely shock-excited

evidence.quote: revealing a strong outflow activity with gas expelled at velocities of at least $\rm 350 \, km \, s^{-1}$ from the nuclear region

why_this_method.value: Point-source modelling first for efficient exploration, then pixelated source reconstruction

evidence.quote: This approach is computationally efficient and facilitates a thorough exploration.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Models with four galaxies only rejected; cored and NFW halos equally good; elliptical halo and non-isothermal galaxy profiles briefly tested

evidence.quote: We briefly explored two ways to generalize the cored halo models.

limitations_admitted.value: Halo internal structure and magnification are poorly constrained; lens redshifts uncertain

evidence.quote: the internal structure of the dark matter halo cannot be constrained with the current data

referee_caveats_inferred: Lens model assumes spherical halo and single lens plane with photometric redshifts
Halo mass depends on extrapolation to large radii
Short 3-min ALMA observation limits S/N for source reconstruction
